name: car-fuel-economy-scraper
title: Car Fuel Economy Scraper: MPG, EV Range & CO2 by Model
description: Look up official US EPA fuel economy for any car, 1984 to today. Paste "year make model" lines and get city/highway/combined MPG, fuel type, EV range, CO2 per mile, annual fuel cost and transmission per variant. For dealers, car apps and fleet buyers. No API key needed.
